title: Siman 289
section: The Greatness and Awesomeness of His Attainments

segments.he: אָמַרשֶׁפָּעַל אֵצֶל הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ שֶׁכְּשֶׁבָּאִין לְפָנָיו
segments.en: (49.) I heard from his holy mouth that he said: "I am a new vessel full of old." And it is also found in his holy handwriting: "I am the elder of holiness etc. who reveals things that the Ancient of Days concealed etc."
